vb_textbox.text: My advice is that the coloured ones are the ones to go for if you have a choice between a coloured gnome and a grey or black gnome as I found that the coloured gnomes give you the most mushrooms.I would only change this action if you are presented with a grey or black gnome then I suggest you choose grey over black.So, in summary, coloured gnome beforegrey, and grey before black.
